From 343a1772ce6ac03e48b228d2d7168d19750e3f36 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Nicolas Grekas <nicolas.grekas@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:49:55 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] [HttpFoundation] Remove the ambiguity that makes
 HeaderUtils::split() backtrack

The token branch of the pattern matched whitespace, so a run of whitespace
before a separator could be split between the iterations of the enclosing
quantifier in as many ways as it had characters, and the trailing assertion
forced the engine to enumerate them. Parsing a header holding such runs cost
seconds of CPU, and past the backtracking limit the match failed altogether
and the header was silently parsed as nothing.

Whitespace is now consumed only when more of the value follows it. A value can
therefore never end on whitespace, nothing has to be given back, and every
quantifier can be possessive. What the separator branch sees is unchanged.
Whitespace characters used as separators are left out of the whitespace branch,
so splitting "foo bar" on a space still returns two values.

(cherry picked from commit 47f3a4e2c52a687b2cee188a3ac2275ab5302833)
(cherry picked from commit 9ffa802e5d7e9fb8ba95eeefd27e863e83b1baca)
---
 .../Component/HttpFoundation/HeaderUtils.php  |  9 +++++---
 .../HttpFoundation/Tests/HeaderUtilsTest.php  | 22 ++++++++++++++++++-
 2 files changed, 27 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/Symfony/Component/HttpFoundation/HeaderUtils.php b/src/Symfony/Component/HttpFoundation/HeaderUtils.php
index 110896e1776d1..697b31823b2cd 100644
--- a/src/Symfony/Component/HttpFoundation/HeaderUtils.php
+++ b/src/Symfony/Component/HttpFoundation/HeaderUtils.php
@@ -58,9 +58,12 @@ public static function split(string $header, string $separators): array
                         "(?:[^"\\\\]|\\\\.)*(?:"|\\\\|$)
                     |
                         # token
-                        [^"'.$quotedSeparators.']+
-                    )+
-                (?<!\s)
+                        [^"\s'.$quotedSeparators.']++
+                    |
+                        # whitespace that is not a separator, only when more of the value follows it,
+                        # so that a value never ends on whitespace and none of it ever has to be given back
+                        [^\S'.$quotedSeparators.']++(?!['.$quotedSeparators.']|$)
+                    )++
             |
                 # separator
                 \s*
diff --git a/src/Symfony/Component/HttpFoundation/Tests/HeaderUtilsTest.php b/src/Symfony/Component/HttpFoundation/Tests/HeaderUtilsTest.php
index 3279b9a53b47d..28de1e2fd3a89 100644
--- a/src/Symfony/Component/HttpFoundation/Tests/HeaderUtilsTest.php
+++ b/src/Symfony/Component/HttpFoundation/Tests/HeaderUtilsTest.php
@@ -43,6 +43,10 @@ public static function provideHeaderToSplit(): array
             [['foo bar'], 'foo "bar"', ','],
             [['foo bar'], '"foo" bar', ','],
             [['foo bar'], '"foo" "bar"', ','],
+            [['foo', 'bar'], 'foo bar', ' '],
+            [['foo', 'bar'], 'foo   bar', ' '],
+            [[['foo', 'bar'], ['baz']], 'foo bar, baz', ', '],
+            [['foo bar', 'baz'], "foo bar\tbaz", "\t"],
 
             [[['foo_cookie', 'foo=1&bar=2&baz=3'], ['expires', 'Tue, 22-Sep-2020 06:27:09 GMT'], ['path', '/']], 'foo_cookie=foo=1&bar=2&baz=3; expires=Tue, 22-Sep-2020 06:27:09 GMT; path=/', ';='],
             [[['foo_cookie', 'foo=='], ['expires', 'Tue, 22-Sep-2020 06:27:09 GMT'], ['path', '/']], 'foo_cookie=foo==; expires=Tue, 22-Sep-2020 06:27:09 GMT; path=/', ';='],
@@ -183,4 +187,20 @@ public function testParseQueryIgnoreBrackets()
         $this->assertSame(['a.b[]' => ['A']], HeaderUtils::parseQuery('a.b[]=A', true));
         $this->assertSame(['a.b[]' => ['A']], HeaderUtils::parseQuery('a.b%5B%5D=A', true));
     }
-}
+
+    /**
+     * A run of whitespace before a separator must not make the parser give up: the token branch
+     * of the pattern used to match that whitespace and hand it back one character at a time.
+     */
+    public function testSplitIsNotAmbiguousAboutWhitespaceBeforeSeparators()
+    {
+        $this->assertSame([["a"], ["b"]], HeaderUtils::split("a".str_repeat(" ", 25).",b", ",="));
+        $this->assertSame([[["a"]], [["b"]]], HeaderUtils::split("a".str_repeat(" ", 25).",b", ",;="));
+        $this->assertSame([["x", "1"], ["y", "2"]], HeaderUtils::split("x=1".str_repeat(" ", 25).";y=2", ";="));
+
+        $header = str_repeat("a".str_repeat(" ", 25).",", 200);
+        $this->assertCount(200, HeaderUtils::split($header, ",="));
+
+        // whitespace inside a value is still part of it
+        $this->assertSame([["a b  c"]], HeaderUtils::split("a b  c", ",="));
+    }}
